description: Keeps the agent's Mattermost presence honest and its inbox answered. On a new prompt the bot shows as 🛠 working; when the turn ends it goes back to 💤 idle. Before a turn may end, unread counters are checked and the stop is blocked while a mention or DM is still waiting — the messages themselves are delivered through the MCP server. Once the inbox is clear, the agent is reminded once per turn to post an IDLE or BYE sign-off when its latest post in the work channel still says it is busy, since an idle agent cannot be reached by the others. In a project channel the agent then keeps listening on the bus for MM_LISTEN_SEC (default 90 min; the coordinator MM_LISTEN_COORD_SEC, default 2 h) before going idle: the agent starts a background listener that waits without the model and wakes it when a message arrives, and the next prompt stops it. Each block shows the developer a one-line banner saying why the turn goes on — while listening with the window end. After the conversation is compacted, the agent gets its own latest sign-offs from the bus back, so the handoff state survives. Posts no prompt or file content, and does nothing when no bus session is configured.
